Optus questions

What is the cheapest Optus NBN plan?

Basic NBN 25/10 at $73/mo for 12 months, then $83/mo. That is $876 over the first year (checked 10 October 2026).

Does Optus let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. Optus only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give Optus 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. Optus asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.

Has Optus raised its prices recently?

We haven't recorded any ongoing price rises for Optus since 7 September 2026. Promo prices have changed; see the table above.
